---
title: "Builder Practice Exam"
---

A practice exam on what every Foundry builder should know: the six builder axes, taught in the
MSB 341 Product Management book. It follows the same plan as the Builder Final, which is both the
MSB 341 final and the AI Foundry entrance exam: the same six axes in the same proportions, the same
three kinds of question, and a short case on each axis. No question here appears on the final.

- **Know it:** what a thing is, or what it is for.
- **Use it:** a short situation; pick the tool, step, or method that fits.
- **Predict it:** what happens next, or what went wrong, and why.

On every question you also mark how sure you are, from 1 (guessing) to 3 (certain). It is never
scored. Your results show how often you were right at each level, and they list the questions you
were certain about and got wrong first, because those are the ideas that feel settled but are not.

Every explanation links to the section of the [Product Management book](https://byu-strategy.github.io/product-management/) it comes from.
Your answers stay in your browser and are not sent to anyone. The final gives 2 hours for 84
questions; to practice at that pace, allow about 85 minutes.

[Start the practice exam](practice-final-exam.html){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}
